description: Provide versioned public-finance and health-system perspective valuation, excise/GST tax-transfer separation and subgroup equity-weighting interfaces for tobac regulatory policy evaluation.
external_dependencies: edithatogo/tobac: tobacco/vaping cohort state trajectories, cessation intervention pathways and customs/excise policy scenarios (F04, F05).
edithatogo/voiage: paired-outcome, value-of-perspective and credal dominance contracts.
completion_evidence: Health-system direct medical costs and public-finance excise/GST transfers are represented as distinct typed accounting lines; societal totals never add transfer payments to real resource costs without an explicit net-transfer rule.
Differential and uniform discounting reference cases match independent exact arithmetic across annual and sub-annual cohort steps.
Subgroup and equity-stratum identities survive valuation and discounting without silent pooling across Maori / non-Maori or socioeconomic quintiles.
Paired parameter/replication draw keys are preserved end-to-end when exporting valued net-benefit tables to tobac and voiage.
Disabling the optional dapane adapter in tobac leaves tobac's standalone reference oracle intact.
